title: Finder locator report
description: The one answer of a finder seat: exactly the four locator lists, no other field (bead coding-harness-yd8w).

code.description: Functions, modules and files the change touches or could reuse. Never empty: write the unread marker when there is nothing else.

anyOf.description: A locator: one exact place in the repository.

reference.description: The exact, case-sensitive symbol or section: a Python symbol is a definition or a module-level assignment (dotted for nested definitions); a Markdown reference is the text of one ATX heading, or `criterion <n>`; a YAML or JSON reference is a dotted key path. Line numbers, bare paths and prose are not references.

reason.description: One sentence why this place matters.

anyOf.description: An explicit unread marker, only when nothing was found or a place could not be read. "Not found" and "not read" are different statements; write them as two.

not_read.description: What was not read or found, and why.
